# Links module, page and route

## `src/about/links.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Every legal URL the app links to, in one place. The About page, the public footer and the cookie banner import
 * these; override per deployment with VITE_* variables.
 */

export const LEGAL_LINKS = [
  { key: "impressum", href: import.meta.env.VITE_IMPRESSUM_URL ?? "/impressum" },
  { key: "terms", href: import.meta.env.VITE_TERMS_URL ?? "/terms" },
  { key: "privacy", href: import.meta.env.VITE_PRIVACY_URL ?? "/privacy" },
] as const;

export type LegalLinkKey = (typeof LEGAL_LINKS)[number]["key"];

/** Generated by rollup-plugin-license at build time; see vite.config.ts. */
export const LICENSES_URL = `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}third-party-licenses.txt`;

export const COMMIT_HASH = __COMMIT_HASH__;
export const SHORT_HASH = COMMIT_HASH === "unknown" ? COMMIT_HASH : COMMIT_HASH.slice(0, 7);

const repo = import.meta.env.VITE_REPO_URL?.replace(/\/$/, "");
export const COMMIT_URL = repo && COMMIT_HASH !== "unknown" ? `${repo}/commit/${COMMIT_HASH}` : undefined;
```

## `src/routes/about.tsx`

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { Check, Copy, ExternalLink } from "lucide-react";
import { COMMIT_HASH, COMMIT_URL, LEGAL_LINKS, LICENSES_URL, SHORT_HASH } from "@/about/links";

/** A link that opens in a new tab and says so to screen readers. */
function NewTabLink({ href, children }: { href: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation("about");
  return (
    <a
      href={href}
      target="_blank"
      rel="noopener noreferrer"
      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-medium text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
    >
      {children}
      <ExternalLink aria-hidden className="size-3.5" />
      <span className="sr-only">{t("newTab")}</span>
    </a>
  );
}

function CopyHash() {
  const { t } = useTranslation("about");
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  if (COMMIT_HASH === "unknown") return null;
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={async () => {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(COMMIT_HASH);
        setCopied(true);
        setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500);
      }}
      className="rounded p-1 text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground"
      aria-label={copied ? t("build.copied") : t("build.copy")}
    >
      {copied ? <Check className="size-4" /> : <Copy className="size-4" />}
    </button>
  );
}

export function AboutPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation("about");
  const hash = <code className="font-mono text-sm" title={COMMIT_HASH}>{SHORT_HASH}</code>;

  return (
    <main className="mx-auto max-w-2xl px-4 py-12">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold">{t("title")}</h1>
      <p className="mt-2 text-muted-foreground">{t("description")}</p>

      <dl className="mt-10 divide-y border-y">
        <div className="grid gap-1 py-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <dt className="font-medium">{t("build.label")}</dt>
          <dd className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:col-span-2">
            {t("build.commit")} {COMMIT_URL ? <NewTabLink href={COMMIT_URL}>{hash}</NewTabLink> : hash}
            <CopyHash />
          </dd>
        </div>

        <div className="grid gap-1 py-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <dt className="font-medium">{t("oss.label")}</dt>
          <dd className="sm:col-span-2">
            <p>{t("oss.text")}</p>
            <NewTabLink href={LICENSES_URL}>{t("oss.link")}</NewTabLink>
          </dd>
        </div>

        <div className="grid gap-1 py-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <dt className="font-medium">{t("legal.label")}</dt>
          <dd className="sm:col-span-2">
            <ul className="space-y-1">
              {LEGAL_LINKS.map((l) => (
                <li key={l.key}>
                  <NewTabLink href={l.href}>{t(`legal.${l.key}`)}</NewTabLink>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </dd>
        </div>
      </dl>
    </main>
  );
}
```

Behaviour rules:
- Every outgoing link goes through `NewTabLink`; no other `<a>` on the page.
- The copy button only renders when the hash is known; `navigator.clipboard` needs a secure context (HTTPS or
  localhost), which production has.
- No data fetching, no loading state: everything on the page is a build-time constant.

```json
{
  "title": "About Acme",

```

German (`de/about.json`) uses "Impressum", "Nutzungsbedingungen" (or "AGB"), "Datenschutzerklärung",
"Drittanbieter-Lizenzen", "(öffnet in neuem Tab)".

## Route (`src/router.tsx`, TanStack Router)

```tsx
const aboutRoute = createRoute({
  getParentRoute: () => rootRoute, // not the authenticated app layout
  path: "/about",
  component: lazyRouteComponent(() => import("./routes/about"), "AboutPage"),
  head: () => ({ meta: [{ title: "About · Acme" }] }),
});
```

React Router equivalent: `{ path: "/about", lazy: () => import("./routes/about").then((m) => ({ Component: m.AboutPage })) }`
at the top level, beside the login route.

## Menu entry

```tsx
<DropdownMenuItem asChild>
  <Link to="/about">
    <Info className="size-4" /> {t("menu.about")}
  </Link>
</DropdownMenuItem>
```

The About page opens in the same tab. Add the same three `LEGAL_LINKS` to the public footer so the Impressum is
reachable from every public page.
